summary: Resolves a1 through TableLookupByIndex; special result values 9875 and 9876 pass through unchanged, and negative results are rejected. Otherwise returns the indexed WORD from one of two tables (word_5BEBB0 when a2 is 0, word_5BF2F8 when a2 is 1), or -1 for any other a2.

operations.description: result = TableLookupByIndex(a1) — resolve the input to a table index or special value.
If result equals 9875 or 9876, return result directly without table lookup.
If result is negative (>= 0 fails), return -1 as an error.
When a2 is 0, return the WORD word_5BEBB0[result] from the first table.
When a2 is 1, return the WORD word_5BF2F8[result] from the second table.
For any a2 other than 0 or 1, return -1.

unresolved: The meanings of the 9875/9876 pass-through sentinels and of the two tables (which word is being selected, from a2) depend on the caller FontRenderingPrep, which is not analyzed in this packet.
